title: Azadaro Moharram Aa Raha Hai
body:
AZADARO MOHARRAM AA RAHA HAI
Chalo aao azakhana sajaye azadaro moharram aa raha hai..(2)
Gharo me farsh majlis ka bichaye azadaro moharram aa gaya hai
1) Rakho zehno me mashkiza jari ka
Tadapti reh gai pyasi sakina
Sabile yaad me uski lagaye
Chalo aao azakhana sajaye azadaro moharram aa raha hai..(2)
2) Hum ashura sare maqtal karenge
Waha pe khoon ka pursa b denge
Chalo ab tez zanjeere karaye
Chalo aao azakhana sajaye azadaro moharram aa raha hai..(2)
3) Sukoo unka hai ye ansoo tumara
Isi ki muntazir rehti hain zehra
Chalo shabbir pe ansoo bahaye
Chalo aao azakhana sajaye azadaro moharram aa raha hai..(2)
4) Jaha majlis ho shahe karbala ki
Chali aati hain pursa lene bibi
Hum apne ghar me zehra ko bulaye
Chalo aao azakhana sajaye azadaro moharram aa raha hai..(2)
5) Hua pamal dulha karbala me
Dulhan bewa hui hai nainawa me
Hasan k laal ki mehandi uthaye
Chalo aao azakhana sajaye azadaro moharram aa raha hai..(2)
6) Yahi armaan tha shahe huda ka
Sajaye sar pe wo akbar k sehra
Chalo taboot pe sehra sajaye
Chalo aao azakhana sajaye azadaro moharram aa raha hai..(2)
7) Hai hajat "ARSALAN" e ghumzada ki
Koi ashur ho imran yu bhi
Imam e waqt ko nauha sunaye
Chalo aao azakhana sajaye azadaro moharram aa raha hai..(2)
